fusions.name: Landing Kick
fusions.desc: Drops a heavy kick on the target for 13 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and drives it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Hobbling Rake
fusions.desc: Rakes every enemy within 2 tiles with your talons, dealing 6 damage and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Thermal Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Migration Rhythm
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
